displayName: Write a demo script tailored to a specific prospect
summary: Turn any prospect's context into a personalised demo that speaks to their situation.

useCases.title: Write a demo script tailored to a specific prospect
useCases.message: Help me prepare a personalised demo for a prospect. Ask me who I am demoing to and when. Then go find their company context: their website, LinkedIn, recent news, and any emails we have exchanged. You might want to identify their likely pain points before structuring the script. Then write a demo flow that speaks directly to their situation.
